title: Power to cause registration of** [1][waqf] and to amend register
text:
41. Power to cause registration of [waqf] and to amend register.—The Board may direct a

mutawalli to apply for the registration of a [waqf], or to supply any information regarding a [waqf] or
may itself cause the [waqf] to be registered or may at any time amend the register of [auqaf].
